name: Constituency Pattern
description: The constituency pattern. It is extracted from DOLCE-UltraLite by partial clone of elements.
competency_questions: What is a given object made up of at a finer level of description - which cells make up a tissue, or which molecules make up a person?; What do a given set of people, molecules or atoms make up at a coarser level of description - for example, which social system do these people constitute?
competency_questions_source: derived from the pattern's own axioms during the OntoBoard review and checked against them; the upstream submission states none
